read.thesis: Large ag is below trough with North American new high-hp tractor inventory down over 50% from peak, while C&F order backlog up 60%+ since November; South America industry cut to down 15%, and net income guide held at $4.5-5B.

triggers.label: New high-hp inventory down >50% from peak
